knowledge:
- key_parameters: mirnafile=Path to the tab-delimited text file containing miRNA expression data or miRNA-gene associations ;; pvaluecol=Column name for P-values in the miRNA expression file ;; groupcol=Column name for sample groups ;; mirnacol=Column name for miRNA names ;; assayidcol=Column name for assay IDs to discriminate multiple assays for the same miRNA ;; genecol=Column name for gene identifiers ;; pathwayfile=Path to the tab-delimited text file containing gene-pathway associations ;; pathwaycol=Column name for pathway names ;; Composite=Logical flag in runEnrichment indicating whether to treat fully expanded miRNA-gene combinations as separate enrichment events (TRUE) or treat all effects on one gene as one collective event (FALSE) ;; permutations=Number of permutations for randomizing miRNA hits to calculate permutation P-values ;; format=Format of the output table in mirnaTable ('Tall' or 'Wide') ;; Significance=P-value threshold for filtering results in mirnaTable
- alternatives: The documentation mentions using target prediction algorithms like Miranda and RNAHybrid separately or using overlapping predictions to build confidence, but does not list alternative R packages.
- when_to_use: Use when you have differential miRNA expression data (with P-values, fold changes, etc.), miRNA-to-gene target predictions, and gene-to-pathway annotations, and you want to identify enriched pathways while accounting for the many-to-many relationships between miRNAs and genes.
- pitfalls: Combining miRNA expression, miRNA-gene, and gene-pathway links into a single file yields prohibitively large datasets that exceed memory limits; they must be kept in separate files and loaded sequentially ;; Identical naming conventions must be used across all files (miRNA names in expression and miRNA-gene files must match; gene names in miRNA-gene and gene-pathway files must match) ;; If no assay ID is applicable, the miRNA name column must be re-used for assayidcol ;; Filtering criteria are additive; all specified criteria (P-value, fold change, expression) must be met for an entry to be considered a hit.

workflows.name: mirna_pathway_enrichment
workflows.intent: Perform composite pathway enrichment analysis on miRNA expression data by integrating miRNA-gene targets and gene-pathway associations.
input: mirnaTable.txt (tab-delimited text file with miRNA expression data, including columns for miRNA Name, ASSAYID, GROUP, and P-value)
mirnaGene.txt (tab-delimited text file with miRNA-to-gene target associations, including columns for miRNA Name, Entrez Gene ID, and ASSAYID)
mirnaPathways.txt (tab-delimited text file with gene-to-pathway associations, including columns for Pathway Name and Entrez Gene ID)
workflows.stages: 1. Load miRNA expression data using loadmirnapath ;; 2. Filter miRNA data for hits using filtermirnapath ;; 3. Load miRNA-gene associations using loadmirnatogene ;; 4. Load gene-pathway associations using loadmirnapathways ;; 5. Run pathway enrichment analysis using runEnrichment ;; 6. Export and format enrichment results using mirnaTable ;; 7. Visualize results using a heatmap
